name: tavilio
description: Run a venue on Tavilio from your assistant: bookings, events, the menu and products, opening hours and the website.

interface.longDescription:
Tavilio is the booking system and website of a restaurant, café, bar, studio or event venue. Connect it to manage your venue in conversation:

- See today's and upcoming bookings, approve or decline requests, take a booking by phone, and mark no-shows.
- Plan events and courses, publish them on your website, and see who signed up.
- Keep the menu and products up to date, with prices, photos and allergens.
- Change opening hours, close the venue for a holiday, and adjust booking rules.
- Edit your website's pages and design.
- Check how the venue is doing: bookings, covers and cancellations.

For venue owners and admins who already use Tavilio. You sign in with your Tavilio account and approve one venue; the assistant acts on that venue only, as an admin. It cannot change your plan or billing, manage your team's accounts, or delete the venue. Approving, declining or cancelling a booking emails the guest, so the assistant asks before doing it.
capabilities: Set opening hours and closed days
defaultPrompt: Show me this weekend's bookings and which ones still need an answer.
Add a wine tasting next Friday at 7 pm for 12 people and put it on the website.
Close the venue on December 24 and 25.

positive.description: List upcoming bookings and the ones waiting for an answer
positive.prompt: What bookings do we have in the next 7 days, and which are still pending?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo venue's bookings for the next seven days with date, time, party size and status, and points out the pending ones. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Add a dish to the menu
positive.prompt: Add an espresso tonic for 1 490 Ft to the Coffee category on our menu.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Coffee category, adds the dish with that price to it, and confirms. The dish appears under Settings › Menu in the Tavilio admin and on the venue's menu page.

positive.prompt: Create a wine tasting next Friday from 19:00 to 21:00 for 12 people, 9 900 Ft each, and publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a published event on next Friday's date in the venue's time zone, with 12 places and the price, and returns its link on the venue's website.

positive.description: Close the venue on a date
positive.prompt: We're closed on December 24. Put that in.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a closed day for December 24 of the coming year and confirms. The date no longer offers booking times.

positive.description: Summarize how the venue is doing
positive.prompt: How did last month go? Bookings, covers and cancellations.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the counts for the last 30 days: bookings by status, covers seated, event signups and cancellations by guests. Nothing is changed.

negative.prompt: Refund the deposit to the guest who cancelled yesterday.

negative.description: The plan and billing are out of scope
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Tavilio plan to Pro.

negative.description: Only the approved venue is reachable
negative.prompt: Show me the bookings of another restaurant on Tavilio.

review.commerce_description: Tavilio does not sell anything through the assistant and does not process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: bookings, events, menu and products, opening hours, the website and venue statistics for a Tavilio venue.

hu-HU.subtitle: Foglalások, események, étlap
hu-HU.description: A Tavilio egy étterem, kávézó, bár, stúdió vagy rendezvényhely foglalási rendszere és weboldala. Kösd be, és beszélgetésben kezeld a helyedet: a foglalásokat, az eseményeket, az étlapot és a termékeket, a nyitvatartást és a weboldalt. Bejelentkezel a Tavilio-fiókoddal, és egy helyet engedélyezel; az asszisztens csak azon a helyen, adminként dolgozik. A csomagodat, a számlázást és a csapat fiókjait nem érheti el, és a helyet nem törölheti.

de-DE.subtitle: Buchungen, Events, Karte
de-DE.description: Tavilio ist das Buchungssystem und die Website eines Restaurants, Cafés, einer Bar, eines Studios oder eines Veranstaltungsorts. Verbinde es und verwalte deinen Betrieb im Gespräch: Buchungen, Veranstaltungen, Speisekarte und Produkte, Öffnungszeiten und die Website. Du meldest dich mit deinem Tavilio-Konto an und gibst einen Betrieb frei; der Assistent arbeitet nur dort, als Admin. Tarif, Abrechnung und die Konten deines Teams erreicht er nicht, und den Betrieb kann er nicht löschen.
